brief.title: Agent 的工作循环
brief.narration: 那它到底怎么干活？靠的就是一个循环，这是它的“心脏”。第一步，你提需求：帮我修好这个 bug。第二步，模型想一想：我下一步该干什么？第三步，动手：可能是打开一个文件看看，搜一段代码，或者跑一条命令。第四步，也是最妙的地方——不管结果是成功还是报错，都原样丢回给模型看。然后回到第二步，接着想下一步。就这样一圈一圈地转，直到模型觉得搞定了，循环才停下来。你发现了吗？这里没有专门的规划师，也没有复杂的出错处理。规划，是模型每转一圈都在重新盘算的，比死板的计划灵活得多。报错，在它眼里跟成功没区别，都只是“一条新信息”。看到了，自己调整就行——这跟我们程序员看到红色报错、挠挠头改一改，一模一样。所以你看，聪明不在某一步里，而在“转很多圈”的累积里。
brief.visualGoal: 用一个持续在场的闭环解释模型、工具、结果的反馈关系。任务作为可识别的载荷沿路径移动；报错不是终点，而是下一轮的输入。图形与空间关系承担解释，不以多个文字卡片切换代替机制。
facts: 模型依据工具结果决定下一步。
工具成功与报错都能作为下一轮信息。
画面是简化的教学示意，不是完整产品内部结构。

thesis: The agent loop is one continuous cardiac circuit: a single recognizable task-payload travels request -> think -> act -> result and is visibly fed back into think, so error and success re-enter as the same kind of next input rather than ending the flow.
metaphor: A blueprint heart-pump circuit. The loop is drawn as one thick continuous chamber ring with four valve junctions (request, think, act, result); the task is a glowing cyan bug-tag pellet that is pumped around the ring. A gold return pipe arcs from the result chamber back into the think chamber — the visual heart of the mechanism. Error results are recolored but take the identical return pipe, proving they are just another input.

objects.meaning: The single continuous agent cycle that is always on screen (the heart chamber ring)
objects.appearance: One thick annular band of blueprint-navy with a lighter cyan inner edge, not four separate rounded cards; four bulbous valve junctions bulge outward at 12, 3, 6 and 9 o'clock; faint concentric construction arcs and seam hairlines give it a machined chamber feel

objects.meaning: Step one: the user submits the request
objects.appearance: Upper-left chamber junction on the ring, a flared mouth with two inward-facing cyan lips; a small intake notch where the payload enters

objects.meaning: Step two: the model decides the next step
objects.appearance: Right-side chamber junction, a rounded lobe inside the ring with three short internal cyan ridge lines suggesting deliberation; a gold contact point on its outer edge where the return pipe lands

objects.meaning: Step three: the tool acts (open file, search, run command)
objects.appearance: Lower chamber junction drawn as a small terminal mouth with a short horizontal slot and two angled jaw plates; a tiny cyan cursor bar sits in the slot

objects.meaning: Step four: the tool result, success or error
objects.appearance: Left-lower chamber junction with an open catch-basin lip facing upward; a small framed window shows either a cyan check-less slot or a red-gold error slot depending on state

objects.meaning: The one recognizable task (fix this bug) that travels the whole loop and recurs round after round
objects.appearance: A folded-corner tag pellet with a distinct bug glyph cut into it, cyan body with gold fold; small trailing motion streaks when moving; identical object every lap

objects.meaning: The real feedback path: result is thrown back into think
objects.appearance: A thick gold pipe arcing from the result-valve catch-basin up and right into the think-valve gold contact; visible continuously, with a small inlet funnel at the think end

objects.meaning: An error is a new piece of information, not a dead end
objects.appearance: A short red-gold jagged tag that snaps onto the task-payload when a result is an error, then is carried along the return pipe; not a separate card

objects.meaning: Many laps accumulate; competence is in the turning
objects.appearance: Three faint concentric cyan ghost rings offset inside the loop-ring, appearing progressively to imply accumulation without any invented numbers or ticks

objects.meaning: Loop stops only when the model deems it done
objects.appearance: A narrow gate on the ring near the think-valve that opens with a gold seam when the payload is marked solved; the payload then exits the ring briefly and rests, not into a caption card

objects.meaning: Title text, subordinate to the mechanism
objects.appearance: Upper-left clear area reserved for the scene title; no mechanism geometry intrudes

beats.action: Establish the full continuous cardiac ring with all four valve junctions and the gold return pipe already drawn; the task-payload sits at the request valve mouth. This is a recognizable mechanism silhouette on frame one, not an empty outline.
The user's request enters: the payload drops into the request-valve intake notch and seats there, bug glyph facing camera.
The payload is pumped from request-valve around the top of the ring into the think-valve; the think lobe's deliberation ridges pulse.
The payload travels down the right side into the act-valve terminal mouth; the cursor bar scans the slot as the tool acts.

The payload is expelled from act-valve down into the result-valve catch-basin. The result window resolves; on an error it shows the red-gold slot. Critically, the same payload is then lifted onto the return pipe.

changes.to: in result-valve basin, then on return pipe
window showing result (error slot in the error pass)
carrying the payload back toward think

beats.action: The payload rides the gold pipe back into the think-valve gold contact, closing the loop; the ghost concentric rings appear as a second lap begins. The path is real and continuous, not a disconnected card.
Emphasize that planning happens inside the turning: on each pass the think-valve re-pulses its ridges with no separate planner object appearing anywhere. The ring turns again.

A result comes back as an error: the red-gold error-mark snaps onto the payload, and both are thrown along the identical return pipe back into think. The error is shown as the same kind of next input, then the payload is marked solved and the done-gate opens at the think-valve.

changes.to: open gold seam, payload exits ring

composition: 1920x1080 blueprint navy field. Title zone upper-left (x140-660,y90-210) kept clear. Dominant mechanism occupies center x480-1440,y170-870: one continuous loop-ring with four valve junctions at request (upper-left), think (right), act (lower-center), result (lower-left). Draw order: loop-ring base band -> spiral-accumulation ghost rings -> actuated valves (act jaws behind slot) -> task-payload and error-mark -> return-pipe arc over/behind the ring but in front of background -> think/result valve front lips occluding the pipe ends. The return-pipe is drawn behind the think-valve front lip so the payload appears to dock, and in front of the loop-ring band so its path reads. Output/done zone at right of think-valve (x1380-1700,y250-470) where the solved payload rests fully visible. Bottom 100px (y980-1080) is reserved caption safe area; no object or line enters it. Labels sit beside valves, subordinate and readable at playback size, with no line crossing them.
avoid: decorative dashboard gauges or fake meters
error shown as a disconnected discard card
separate planner object or separate error-handler object
acceptance: First frame shows a recognizable continuous chamber ring with four valve junctions, the gold return pipe, and the bug-tag payload at the request mouth — not a faint empty rectangle.
Middle state (cue-5) shows the same payload expelled at result-valve and then lifted onto the return pipe, with result-valve front lip occluding the pipe end.

Final frame (cue-8) shows the error-mark snapped onto the payload being thrown back along the identical return pipe into think, then the payload marked solved exiting through the open done-gate fully visible.
Error and success both travel the same return pipe into the think-valve; no discarded error card appears.
Planning is visibly re-pulsed inside the think-valve each lap; no separate planner object exists.
All labels remain readable at playback size; no line crosses a label; nothing enters the bottom 100px.
Draw order verified: ring band behind valves, return-pipe behind think front lip and in front of ring, inserted payload occluded by valve lips, solved payload fully outside the ring.
